Client Agreement – 100 Days Healthy Eating & Weight Management Program

1. Program Overview

The 100 Days Program is a personalized nutrition and lifestyle guidance plan designed and monitored by a Clinical Dietitian.

The goal is to help you achieve sustainable weight management, improved health, and lasting lifestyle changes through a structured, evidence-based approach — without crash diets or shortcuts.

2. Assessment & Plan

  • A detailed initial assessment will be conducted via Zoom before starting the program.
  • Based on your health details, dietary preferences, and goals, a personalized meal plan will be designed.
  • Clients are requested to share relevant medical reports and current medications before the consultation for accurate planning.
  • Plans will be updated periodically based on your progress, feedback, and results.

3. Payment Policy

  • Full payment must be made before the program begins.
  • Payments are accepted via UPI transfer (details will be shared privately).
  • Once payment is made, the fee is non-refundable and non-transferable, as the program is fully customized for each client.
  • In the unlikely event that the dietitian is unable to continue the program due to an emergency or unavoidable situation, you will be offered:
    • A partial refund for the remaining period, or
    • The option to resume the program later, once services resume — whichever you prefer.

4. Follow-up & Communication

  • Daily follow-ups and updates will be maintained via WhatsApp.
  • Usual response time: within working hours (10 AM – 7 PM, Monday to Saturday).
  • Sundays and public holidays are non-working days.
  • If the dietitian remains unavailable for more than 5 consecutive working days without prior notice, the program duration will be extended so that you do not lose any active service days.
  • Clients are expected to stay in touch and provide regular updates on weight, food logs, and progress.

5. Client Responsibilities

  • The client must follow the given plan consistently and communicate any health changes, side effects, or new medications immediately.
  • The outcome of the program depends on the client's commitment, adherence, and honesty in following the plan.
  • Avoid sharing or reusing the personalized plan for others, as each program is designed specifically for the individual.
  • The dietitian will not be responsible for unsatisfactory results if the plan is not followed as instructed.

6. Confidentiality

All personal, medical, and contact details shared during the program will remain strictly confidential and used only for nutrition planning, progress monitoring, and communication purposes.

7. Media & Testimonials

  • Transformation photographs, progress screenshots, or WhatsApp feedback messages may be used by the dietitian for educational and promotional purposes (such as Instagram posts, stories, or website testimonials).
  • The client's identity will not be revealed if they prefer to stay anonymous.
  • Any such photographs or testimonials will be posted only after obtaining the client's explicit consent.
  • The client reserves the right to decline permission for sharing their images or messages, and this will not affect their participation in the program in any way.

8. Program Extension or Pause

If you need to pause the program for personal or medical reasons, you may do so once, with prior notice, and resume within a mutually agreed time frame. No additional charges will apply for this pause, provided the remaining duration is resumed within that period.

9. Disclaimer

  • This program is intended for nutrition and lifestyle improvement and is not a substitute for medical treatment.
  • Individual results may vary depending on health condition, metabolism, and consistency.
  • The dietitian does not promote or endorse crash diets, supplements, or shortcuts to achieve rapid results.

Client Declaration

I, __________________________, have read and understood the above terms and conditions of the 100 Days Healthy Eating & Weight Management Program conducted by Dietitian Karpagam Ramesh.

I agree to participate in the program under these terms and confirm that all personal and medical information provided by me is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge.

Client Signature: __________________________

Date: __________________________

Dietitian: Karpagam Ramesh – M.Sc Clinical Dietitian

Instagram: @dietitian_karpagam
